headline: GNFC submits postal ballot scrutinizer report and voting results to exchanges
hook: Postal ballot voting results now finalized
summary: Gujarat Narmada Valley Fertilizers and Chemicals Limited has submitted its postal ballot voting results and the scrutinizer's report to the stock exchanges. This routine corporate filing completes the shareholder voting process for resolutions put to postal ballot. Shareholders and retail investors can review the outcome of the voted resolutions on the exchanges. The filing ensures compliance with regulatory disclosure norms for listed companies.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no immediate impact on share price.

headline: GNFC reports 8 percent rise in Q2 profit to Rs 194 crore as revenues climb
hook: Higher costs dent Gujarat Narmada profit
summary: Gujarat Narmada Valley Fertilizers & Chemicals posted a consolidated net profit of Rs 194 crore for the second quarter of FY27, an 8 percent increase compared to the same period last year. Revenue from operations surged 41 percent to Rs 2,773 crore, driven by stronger business volumes. However, bottom-line growth was constrained by rising input costs and higher fixed expenses during the quarter. For Indian retail investors, the earnings highlight margin pressures in the fertilizer and chemicals sector despite top-line expansion.
why_it_matters: Rising input costs squeeze fertilizer sector margins despite revenue growth.
